AGO.note: Local agents are trained for citizen inclusion; civil servants are not stated as trainees.

facts.fact: Presidential Despacho n.º 324/26 authorised US$5 million, World Bank-financed under PADA, for the National Programme for Training Local Agents in Basic Digital Skills, Inclusion and Digital Citizenship, implemented by IMA with FAS support.
